stories.title: Leading China Property Developer Reports Huge loss, in Sign of Widening Real-Estate Woes
stories.summary: Chinese property developer Vanke reported a large loss, adding to concerns that the country's real-estate crisis is widening. The company's difficulties have also raised questions about whether the Chinese state will intervene.

links.headline: Leading China Property Developer Reports Huge loss, in Sign of Widening Real-Estate Woes

stories.title: Freed Israeli Hostages Still Had Shrapnel in Their Bodies From Oct. 7 Attack
stories.summary: Freed Israeli hostages were found to still have shrapnel in their bodies from the October 7 attack, according to an Israeli medical official. Some of the women had been held alone for long periods and spent eight months in tunnels.
